d:
为大家带来一个遗憾的消息：
作者在2月28号的动态中表示由于生活压力，只能放缓作品创作。Matchy认为这样对不起赞助者，便关闭了赞助计划
我将之前下载的作品上传到了e站，至此，Matchy的全部作品在e站就基本收录完全了
很感谢这位画师这么多年来一直为我们带来优秀的作品，据动态描述，作者最近正在制作3D兽耳娘角色「芭斯特」，欢迎大家继续关注最新动态：
https://www.fanbox.cc/@ma
https://www.pixiv.net/users/15578323

It is with regret that I share some news:
In a post on February 28th, the artist stated that due to mounting life pressures, they have no choice but to slow down their creative output. Feeling they could no longer live up to the expectations of their supporters, Matchy has decided to close their sponsorship program.

I have uploaded all the works I previously downloaded to E-Hentai. With this, nearly all of Matchy’s creations are now fully archived on the site.

I’m truly grateful to this artist for bringing us so many outstanding works over the years. According to their update, they are currently working on a 3D kemonomimi character named Bastet. Everyone is welcome to keep following their latest updates.
https://www.fanbox.cc/@ma
https://www.pixiv.net/users/15578323
